title: Space Jam
overview:
It's the ultimate pick-up game. Michael Jordan, Bugs Bunny, Porky Pig, Daffy Duck, and Lola Bunny vs. a mean team of outlandish alien Monstars! This is intergalactic hoops according to the Big Slam Theory! Extraterrestrial dunks! Anti-gravitational alley-oops! Stellar gameplay! And a bunch of mini-games overstuffed with wacky cartoon mayhem! Earth just wasn't big enough.

Space Jam!
